title: ADR-0094: the 2026-09-04 amendment's tripwire `git grep -c "this.runMutationProjector(" -- protocol.ts` no longer answers 7 (the seven call sites moved to the protocol facet files)
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up named by work in flight: O-1 of the at-tier contract review 6901691666 on PR #34138, card #34077; outside that PR's claimed edits, different cause). Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open ADR-0094 tripwire` and `runMutationProjector seven sites`: only #34077.

Blocked-by: #34077 (PR #34138, same file; serial).

## 维护者速读

- 内容:只改 ADR-0094 的一处说明,不改代码。2026-09-04 修订说投影器「在同一个文件里有七个调用点」,并给了一条自检命令 `git grep -c "this.runMutationProjector(" -- packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`,说「在本树上回 7,回别的就说明上面的表过时了」。protocol 拆成 facet 文件之后,这条命令在 main 上已不回 7(调用点改成 `host.runMutationProjector(`,分布在 `protocol-save.ts`、`protocol-history-and-publish.ts`、`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`、`protocol-package-commits.ts`),但钉子测试 `protocol.recovery-doors-mutation-projector.test.ts` 仍跨这些文件数到七。
- ADR 属受管文件,需要您亲手合并或批准后由席位落地。

## What to write

ADR-0094, the 2026-09-04 amendment, around "called from seven sites in that same file" and the tripwire block ("which answers `7` on this tree"). On main the count is still seven, but across `protocol.ts` and the split facet modules, as `host.runMutationProjector(`.

1. An add-only, dated ⚠️ pointer (2026-MM-DD, this card) after the tripwire paragraph: the call sites moved with the facet split (name the commit/PR that split them, read from git history), the pin test still counts seven, and the command that re-derives the number on today's tree (read it from the pin test's own matcher, quote it, and check it answers 7 on main).
2. Do not rewrite the original sentence or command; no other sentence moves. Status-line entry only if the record's own convention asks for one.
3. No code, no test, no changeset. Gates: the ADR registry, index and anchor checks.

## Reader

`domain:skills` (`docs/adr/**` is governed: maintainer merge). Size XS. Serial after #34077 (same file).

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
